:::{#exm-double-negation}
#### Removing a double negation
<!-- no-figure: a one-line rewording; nothing to plot -->

Let $P$ be the [proposition](#def-proposition) "$7$ is [odd](number-systems.qmd#def-odd)".
Then $\neg \neg P$ is "it is not the case that $7$ is not odd".
By [double negation](#thm-double-negation),
$\neg \neg P$ says the same thing as $P$:
$7$ is odd.

:::
